candidates.summary: Meta, TikTok and X lost legal challenges to information demands issued by British online-safety regulator Ofcom. The High Court ruled that the demands, which seek data about platforms’ moderation of harmful content, were lawful under the Online Safety Act.
candidates.title: Meta, TikTok and X lose UK challenge to Ofcom data demands

candidates.summary: The euro-area economy expanded 0.4% in the third quarter from the previous quarter, slowing from 0.6% but exceeding economists’ expectations of 0.2%, according to Eurostat’s preliminary estimate. Output across the 21 countries using the euro was 1.3% higher than a year earlier.
candidates.title: Euro-area economy grows 0.4% in third quarter

candidates.summary: President Donald Trump decided to hold campaign rallies in Iowa and Kansas on Sunday after the appearances had initially been canceled. The events were announced days before the U.S. midterm elections.
candidates.title: Trump restores Iowa and Kansas campaign rallies

candidates.summary: A South African court allowed anti-illegal-immigration groups to hold demonstrations in Durban under restrictions imposed to reduce the risk of violence. Police had asked the court to prohibit the marches following unrest connected to a ruling concerning asylum seekers.
candidates.title: South African court permits Durban immigration marches with restrictions
